steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: On 18 September 1931, Japan used the "Mukden Incident" - an explosion on the Japanese-owned South Manchurian Railway - as a pretext to invade Manchuria, a region of northern China. Japan occupied the entire province and set up the puppet state of "Manchukuo" in February 1932. The League's response was slow, weak, and ultimately ineffective.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: In October 1935, Italy invaded Abyssinia (modern Ethiopia), one of the few independent African nations. The League imposed economic sanctions on Italy but they were half-hearted and failed to stop the invasion. By May 1936, Italy had conquered Abyssinia. The crisis was the League's most humiliating failure and effectively destroyed it as a peacekeeping body.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Great Depression that followed the 1929 Wall Street Crash fundamentally changed the international environment. Economic crisis made nations more aggressive, more self-interested, and less willing to cooperate through the League.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The World Disarmament Conference opened in Geneva on 2 February 1932 with 60 nations represented. It was the League's most ambitious attempt to reduce armaments. After nearly 18 months of negotiation, it collapsed completely in June 1934 without achieving any significant agreement.

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Know the exact dates: Manchuria invasion 18 September 1931; Italy invades Abyssinia 3 October 1935; Hoare-Laval Pact December 1935; Haile Selassie's speech 30 June 1936 Manchuria and Abyssinia are the two KEY failures - always compare them in your answers The Hoare-Laval Pact is crucial evidence that Britain and France undermined the League from within Always explain WHY sanctions failed: no oil embargo, Suez Canal open, no American participation The Great Depression is the key CONTEXTUAL factor for explaining the shift from 1920s success to 1930s failure Haile Selassie's warning ("It is us today. It will be you tomorrow") is a powerful quote to use For "why did the League fail" questions, always divide reasons into STRUCTURAL and CIRCUMSTANTIAL
